title: Confused attackers
problem: The Confused chance bonus leaks into the hit's damage pool: +5/+25/+30 flat damage per hit.
notes: Fix: H: clear the pool after use | In-game test: a Confused creature's multi-hit attack: the Confused chance no longer adds to the damage of the following hits (all hits equal). Covered by the SU-0038 per-hit pool reset.

release_notes.intended: A Confused creature's attacks deal normal damage.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the Confused chance leaked into the damage of each following hit of a multi-hit attack, adding a little extra damage.
release_notes.fix: Now the Confused chance no longer adds damage. Covered by SU-0038 (multi-hit attacks).
